summary: The main stylesheet that sets the warm light and dark color themes, the font, and the frosted glass and glow looks used across the app.
purpose: Gives the whole app one consistent look and lets the light and dark modes switch with a single class.
why: Likely reason: colors are stored once as named values so changing a theme means changing one place.
how: 1) Loads the fonts and the Tailwind styling library. 2) Sets the light colors on the root and the dark colors under the dark class. 3) Styles the page body and scrollbars. 4) Defines reusable glass panel, card and glow styles.
inputs: The dark class on the page root, set by the theme provider.
outputs: Colors, fonts, shadows and blur effects on every page.
risks: Some glow and hover colors are fixed values, so they do not change with the theme. Blur effects can slow older devices.
debug: If colors look wrong, check whether the dark class is on the page root and inspect the named color values. If a glow looks off in dark mode, it is probably one of the fixed colors.
